methodology.scope: Independent direct model/IKFK, only Velocity stage. No newClaude audit directory or conclusions read.
methodology.homologous_point: Jointsocketcenter healthyankle_l vs preparedpros_ankle, with parent/child coincidence validated at every pose. This is functional-category homology, not marker/axis/hardware equivalence.
methodology.source_motion: Original23-coordinate healthyEPIC IK includesleftsubtalar/MTP; prepared21-coordinateown IK. Recorded6Hz/order4/1ms zero-phase full-source preprocessing in both.
methodology.time_windows: Same3 immutable measured-force nominalcycles; fullprecisionHS/TO/nextHS+every saved native1ms interior. No startup substitution, new oracle or phase gate.
methodology.phase_bins: 20 equal measuredHS→TO stancebins. Within-cycle time averages, then duration-weighted pool; phase normalization descriptive only.
methodology.identity: Prepared(B−A) = Healthy(B−A) + (PreparedB−HealthyB) − (PreparedA−HealthyA), computed on matching summaries. Vectorcenter/axis and signedY units explicitly separated.
methodology.positive_axis: CustomJoint active oblique rotation axis or PinJointlocalZ; transformed by parentjointframe, checked against childaxis and numerical positive coordinate rotation.
methodology.body_origin: Preparedfoot_l and healthytalus_l bodyorigin each coincide with their anklecenter; healthycalcn_l distalbodyorigin is a separate nonhomologous annotation.

limits: The introduced term is an end-to-end geometrical construction/reference response. It combines mounting, joint replacement, original-versus-markerIK, registration and ownsubjectmotion; it is not an anatomy-only or disease causal effect.
Original healthy subject differences likewise combine geometry, own gait and ownIK/acquisition conventions. Samefunctionalanklecenter does not make subjects interchangeable.
Axisvector budgets are descriptive identities across distinct joint contracts, not an assertion that anatomical and prosthetic axes are identical.
Jointcenterheight is not soleclearance, spherepenetration or measuredmarkerheight. No equivalence with remapped prosthetic markers is used.
No independent floor measurement, hardware experiment or multi-subject statistical inference is introduced.
AB06 original terminal adapterfailure is preserved; only fully supported preselectedprimary physical windows are evaluated.
